text:
maria: FYI control-plane leader in us-west4 lost quorum with the config-store, getting a flood of authz 500s and console 502s. Dedicated GPU pool provisioning jobs are stuck in pending. Investigating, tagging @infra-oncall

infra-oncall: I'm on it. grabbing pod logs, metrics, and etcd status. routing a link to #eng-oncall shortly

leo: seeing `kv-watch` backpressure and election flaps in etcd logs, rpc errors to config-store (timeout 500ms -> 5s)

samir: metrics corroborate — controlplane cpu + rpc error spike at 03:11 UTC, keepalive failures to several region replicas

katie: can we fail over production traffic to na-west2? what about stateful config and TTLs for auth tokens?

infra-oncall: initiating gradual failover plan. updating smart-routing policy to prefer na-west2, keeping a 5% canary to detect regressions. will update LB weights in 2m.

maria: set Dedicated autoscaler to manual to avoid concurrent scale churn, aborting any active scale-up jobs for affected pools

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline paused: 3 config-rollout jobs blocked due to KV write errors (job ids: 7842, 7843, 7844)

leo: also seeing an uptick in auth token cache misses -> identity service fallback returning 503s. suspect cache invalidation/partition.

samir: starting emergency rollback of the recent controlplane config rollout (rollback id 2026-03-18-rc3). I'll announce once rollback triggers.

katie: heads-up: customers with Dedicated reserved capacity might see SLA blips during cross-region serving. CSMs should be notified.

maria: CSMs paged. support playbook opened, moving customer-impacted DRI into the incident doc.

infra-oncall: traffic shift in progress: na-west2 60%, us-west4 35%, canary 5%. Observing error rate and p50/p95 latency now.

maria: initial error rate on API backends down ~70%. console still has intermittent 502s — looks like stale auth tokens or partial config replication.

leo: performing token cache purge on gateway nodes in us-west4: `kubectl -n controlplane exec -it gateway-0 -- /bin/sh -c "redis-cli FLUSHDB"` — running now.

samir: rebootstrap etcd members to restore quorum (removing the flaky follower and rejoining), ETA ~10m, monitoring term/leader election.

katie: please capture cost impact of cross-region egress and any emergency Dedicated bursts for the postmortem. ops/finance will want numbers.

maria: copying logs, request traces, and provisioning failure samples to the incident bucket. tagging incident id IN-2026-03-18-01 for postmortem.

infra-oncall: etcd rebootstrap complete, quorum restored at term 142. rolling health checks greenening. continuing to watch for token errors and config propagation lags. :white_check_mark:
